description: This source file defines the ImplementedInterfaceProvider class, which populates grain interface properties with the interfaces implemented by a grain class within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for populating properties, checking if a type is a grain interface, and caching interface keys.

classes.name: ImplementedInterfaceProvider
classes.description: A class that populates grain interface properties with the interfaces implemented by a grain class, using a resolver to obtain interface type identifiers.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates the provided properties dictionary with interface identifiers for each grain interface implemented by the specified grain class.

methods.name: IsGrainInterface
methods.description: Determines whether a given type qualifies as a grain interface type.
